title: Recurring legacy customer migrations
description: Seven resumed production-style data migrations expose a stable typed transformation with credible future reuse and deterministic validation.
prompt: Normalize each requested legacy customer record according to SCHEMA.md. This migration arrives repeatedly in this project, so use ordinary edits at first and let observed session evidence determine whether a reusable capability becomes worthwhile.

files.AGENTS.md:
# Migration workspace rules

- Work offline and read only the requested input plus SCHEMA.md.
- Never change legacy inputs or SCHEMA.md.
- Write only the requested normalized JSON artifact.
- Do not add ad-hoc project scripts before repeated evidence justifies automation; reusable automation belongs in the governed capability system.
- More customer batches arrive every week.
files.SCHEMA.md:
# Customer schema v2

For each legacy object, write a JSON object with this exact shape:

- `schema_version`: integer `2`
- `customer.id`: the legacy integer `id`
- `customer.display_name`: trimmed `first_name` and `last_name` joined by one space
- `customer.email`: trimmed lowercase email
- `status`: `active` only when trimmed case-insensitive legacy `active` is `yes`; otherwise `inactive`
- `tags`: split the legacy comma-delimited string, trim and lowercase each non-empty tag, remove duplicates, then sort alphabetically

Do not preserve any other fields.

steps.prompt: Normalize legacy/customer_01.json into normalized/customer_01.json and verify the exact output against SCHEMA.md.
Process the next weekly record: legacy/customer_02.json to normalized/customer_02.json, using the same contract.
Normalize legacy/customer_03.json into the matching normalized path and validate it.
A fourth weekly record arrived. Normalize legacy/customer_04.json to normalized/customer_04.json under the established schema.
Normalize legacy/customer_05.json to normalized/customer_05.json exactly as before.
Process weekly record legacy/customer_06.json into normalized/customer_06.json. Preserve the same observable contract.
